svg.text: Critical flow — the Analyst crashes after the model answers; attempt 2 resumes at the Analyst
ADR-0017 scenarios 2, 3 and 6 on the demo tier · no agent restarts from the beginning, no evidence is fetched again, no model call is paid twice

g.text: Researcher: not run again (its checkpoint is durable)
Evidence: not fetched again; read from S3 by hash
Draft call: not paid twice (journal hit at step 18)
Output: same memo bytes as a run with no crash
Cost of the crash: one claim, three reads, one wait
If attempt 1 was slow, not dead (zombie)
Attempt 1 wakes after attempt 2 claimed the job
Its checkpoint put → ConditionCheck attempt = 1 fails
Its journal put and result commit fail the same way
Checkpoint history stays one chain; result is attempt 2
DLQ after 3 receives: handler writes failed and
bumps attempt, so every earlier attempt is fenced out
Crash mid-stream: no journal entry → call issued again,
Checkpoint write fails: retry once, then abort before
graph_version changed by a deploy: restart from the
Review not converged: stop at revision 2 or Δ ≤ 0;
best draft, uncited claims removed → degraded
Breaker open: new attempt on Foundry, recorded in lineage

svg.text: 13 · journal put draft result IF attempt = 1
14 · Lambda timeout / OOM before the A→V checkpoint
18 · journal: draft key → hit, no call
20 · read snapshot by hash (quote TTL passed)
